adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: When Natasha and the others arrive at the Avengers compound, Rhodes cuts off Ross's order to arrest them and welcomes them back. They then fight side by side in Wakanda.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger Rhodes refuses to arrest, then fights beside in Wakanda.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Refuses Ross's order to arrest Natasha and fights beside her in Wakanda.
adds.evidence: At the compound Ross demands Rogers, Wilson, Romanoff, Vision and Maximoff be arrested; Rhodes cuts the transmission and greets his old teammates. Both fight in the Battle of Wakanda.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: When Sam and the others arrive at the Avengers compound, Rhodes cuts off Ross's order to arrest them and welcomes them back. They then fight on the same side in Wakanda.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Back on Rhodes's side. Rhodes refuses to arrest him and fights beside him in Wakanda.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Back on Sam's side. Refuses Ross's order to arrest him and fights beside him in Wakanda.
adds.evidence: Compound scene: Ross orders the arrivals (incl. Wilson) arrested, Rhodes cuts him off, which may end his career, and greets his old teammates; both then defend Wakanda. Turns the Civil War rivalry back to alliance.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: When the wounded Vision reaches the Avengers compound, Rhodes refuses Ross's order to arrest him and the others. Rhodes then fights in Wakanda to keep Thanos's army away from Vision while Shuri works on the Mind Stone.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger Rhodes shelters from Ross, then fights to protect in Wakanda.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Refuses Ross's order to arrest Vision, then fights to protect him in Wakanda.
adds.evidence: Ross is outraged at Vision's disappearance; Rhodes says it is the Accords' fault, then cuts Ross off when he orders the group (incl. Vision) arrested. The Avengers and Wakandans fight to buy Shuri time to remove the Stone from Vision.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: As Thanos's army gathers outside the dome, M'Baku tells Okoye this will be the end of Wakanda, and she answers that it will be the noblest ending in history. They fight side by side in the battle that follows.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Tells M'Baku the coming battle will be the noblest ending in history.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Warns Okoye that the coming battle will be the end of Wakanda.
adds.evidence: Quoted exchange: "This will be the end of Wakanda." / "Then it will be the noblest ending in history." (M'Baku and Okoye), followed by the Battle of Wakanda; both survive the Snap on the field.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: When T'Challa warns of the coming attack, M'Baku brings his Jabari warriors to defend Wakanda. T'Challa thanks him for coming, and they lead the charge against Thanos's army together.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The king who thanks M'Baku for bringing the Jabari to fight.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Brings the Jabari to defend Wakanda at T'Challa's call.
adds.evidence: M'Baku was notified by T'Challa of the incoming threat, gathered the Jabari, was thanked by T'Challa for coming, and went into battle with T'Challa and the Wakandan forces.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Nebula's messages bring Mantis and the Guardians to Titan, and Nebula joins the fight against Thanos there. While Mantis holds Thanos under, Nebula reveals that the grief Mantis senses in him is because he has killed Gamora.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Calls the Guardians to Titan and helps Mantis's team pin down Thanos.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Holds Thanos in a trance on Titan while Nebula joins the fight.
adds.evidence: Mantis finds Nebula's 23 messages telling the Guardians to come to Titan; on Titan Mantis puts Thanos under and says he is mourning, and the newly arrived Nebula reveals he killed Gamora. Mantis later turns to dust on Titan, with Nebula one of the two survivors there.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Mantis and Rocket are together aboard the Guardians' ship when they pull Thor from the wreckage, and she waves goodbye as Rocket leaves with Thor and Groot for Nidavellir.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Mantis waves off when he leaves with Thor.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who waves Rocket off as he leaves with Thor.
adds.evidence: Benatar scene: the Guardians including Mantis and Rocket rescue Thor; Rocket decides to go with Thor and Groot, and as they depart in the pod Mantis waves them goodbye.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Hill is with Fury on a New York street when people start turning to dust, and she fades away in front of him just before he sends a last signal.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Hill's boss and friend, who watches her turn to dust.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's right hand, who turns to dust in front of him.
adds.evidence: Post-credits scene (belongs to the film): Fury and Hill are monitoring the Wakanda battle; Hill turns to dust in front of Fury, who then activates the pager before vanishing.
